list_repo_files: list the contents of a Hugging Face Hub repository directory using the HfFileSystem ls method
download_remote_file: download a remote file from a Hugging Face Hub repository to a local path using get_file
upload_local_file: upload a local file to a Hugging Face Hub repository using HfFileSystemFile._upload_chunk
delete_repo_file: delete files from a Hugging Face Hub repository using the rm method with recursive support
copy_between_repos: copy a file within or between Hugging Face Hub repositories using cp_file
